newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: HBG says Higgs&Hill unit 96 loss stg 5.8m.
newsitem.headline: HBG says Higgs&Hill unit 96 loss stg 5.8m.

text.p: Builder Hollandsche Beton Groep NV said on Tuesday the construction activities it acquired last December from Britain's Higgs&Hill posted a 1996 loss of 5.8 million sterling.
"Higgs&Hill posted a loss of 5.8 million pounds sterling on its construction activities last year," HBG chairman Nic de Ronde Bresser told a results news conference.
HBG earlier reported 1996 net profits rose to 111 million guilders from a year-earlier 104 million.
HBG acquired Higgs&Hill's unit in December and will incorporate it into a new firm with existing UK activities.
These are Kyle Stewart (industrial, commercial and public building) and GA Ltd, active mainly in Scotland and northern England.
The new firm will be named HBG Construction Ltd.
Higgs&Hill's remaining project development and housing activities will be pursued under the name Swan Hill Group.
